authentication.account_bearer: fp_live_ API key or existing dashboard JWT
authentication.revocation: reject new authenticated requests; do not cancel already admitted tasks

profiles.default: fresh profile for each new session
profiles.session_and_profile: both allowed only when the owned session already binds that profile
profiles.same_account_keys: share account authority; do not imply independent profiles
profiles.delete: remove archive, script memory, history and session references; do not retain secret-bearing orphan files

restart.unclaimed_queued_admissions: interrupted; never silently redispatch after restart
restart.failed_profile_save: quarantine bounded recovery artifact; retain prior archive

capacity.admission: reserve global/account capacity before spawn; evict saved idle browsers before rejecting if safe

confirmation.approve: affirmative response authorizes only the exact proposed host-declared action
confirmation.decline: forbids that action; task may inspect state or conclude without performing it
confirmation.arbitrary_javascript: not comprehensively classified or sandbox-enforced by confirmation; do not advertise stronger guarantees

assistance.mint: only active waiting_for_browser generation; rotate and revoke old capabilities on remint
assistance.browser_origin: same external scheme/host/port for POST and WebSocket; missing/null/foreign Origin rejected; normal top-level GET navigation may omit Origin
assistance.forwarded_headers: trust only explicitly configured reverse proxy, never arbitrary clients
assistance.response: release human writer before waking executor

polling.same_revision: return current view after bounded wait
polling.disconnect: stop wait only; never cancel task

secrets.duplicate_response: persist decision metadata plus context-bound receipt_digest keyed HMAC, not values or guessable value hashes; same key/digest returns receipt; changed response conflicts; use constant-time comparison; stable server JWT secret at least 32 bytes; secret rotation retires old receipts
secrets.telemetry: opaque correlation IDs and bounded numeric metrics only
